decision_options.effect: System 8 remains fail-closed until materially new public/auditable exact sources become available for SOFID and BCAP.

Before any new D0 attempt, freeze an ex-ante rule that marks a frozen-universe member structurally ineligible only after documented multi-route exact-source exhaustion under the same public/auditable semantics. Completeness is then measured against the post-rule eligible universe, with excluded members retained in an immutable exclusion ledger and no historical/prospective credit granted for the exclusion itself.
guardrails: Rule must be approved and merged before the next D0 attempt.
No retroactive D0 or historical credit.
No threshold, clock, economics, source-semantic or QA relaxation.
Exclusion requires documented exact-source exhaustion, not mere missing data or temporary outage.
Excluded assets remain visible in an immutable audit ledger and can re-enter only through a separately preregistered future eligibility event.
The eligible-universe denominator must be frozen at the next D0 and cannot change silently within the epoch.
No backfill, stitching, counter reset or synthetic substitute.

human_decision.approval_scope: Authorize only the preregistration of the structural-ineligibility rule described in option B. Approval does not start D0, grant source admission, remove negative evidence, or authorize any other methodology change.
